limitations: One serial-then-parallel timing pair; no repetitions, confidence interval or guaranteed speedup.
Ordinary background applications were active; final Python regression checks also overlapped part of the parallel pilot. These are operational throughput diagnostics, not isolated timings.
Native and Python peak RSS are separate process lifetime maxima; their sum is not a measured simultaneous total RAM value.
Whole-recording source import, query evaluation, compression and collection of the full 72-recording study were not benchmarked.
Concurrent timings cannot establish isolated strategy runtime or real-time deadlines.

The separate concrete adapter retains the existing exact-only ablation catalog; it does not implement or start the proposed semantic-ON/selective-ON study. Its reusable scheduler can be used by that new study.
native_scope: Semantic First / wait / Spatial secondary; semantic generalization enabled, selective suppression cap 0.10, full diagnostics, decision digest enabled. No paced replay.
source_scope: One existing excluded DEV recording, exact 60-second prefix; six repeated computational tasks per arm, not independent scientific samples.
